questions.question:
A company runs EC2 instances in private subnets with no internet access. Administrators currently connect through a bastion host with SSH keys. The security team wants to remove the bastion host, close all inbound ports, control access with IAM, and log every session command.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use AWS Client VPN and allow SSH from the VPN CIDR range.
Use Systems Manager Session Manager with interface VPC endpoints for ssm, ssmmessages, and ec2messages, and configure session logging to S3 or CloudWatch Logs.
Move the bastion host to a private subnet and require MFA for SSH.
Use EC2 Instance Connect with public IP addresses on the instances.

questions.explanation: Session Manager no requiere puertos de entrada ni bastion, se autoriza con IAM y registra las sesiones. En subredes privadas sin internet necesita los VPC endpoints de Systems Manager.

questions.question:
Developers occasionally need SSH access to Linux instances in private subnets. The company wants to avoid long-lived SSH keys and avoid assigning public IP addresses or deploying a bastion host.

Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Store SSH private keys in Secrets Manager and rotate them weekly.
Create an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint in the VPC and use EC2 Instance Connect, which pushes a temporary public key valid for 60 seconds.
Create a NAT gateway and allow SSH from the developers' IP addresses.
Use AWS Verified Access with an SSH endpoint and long-lived keys.

questions.explanation: Instance Connect envía una clave pública temporal (60 segundos) autorizada por IAM; el EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint permite llegar a instancias privadas sin IP pública ni bastion.

questions.question:
A penetration test showed that a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in a web application could be used to retrieve the instance role credentials from the instance metadata service.

Which change BEST mitigates this risk?

options.text: Require IMDSv2 by setting HttpTokens to required on the instances, and enforce it for new instances with the ec2:MetadataHttpTokens condition key in an SCP.
Block 169.254.169.254 in the instance security group.
Enable VPC Flow Logs to detect requests to the metadata service.
Remove the instance profile and store access keys in the application configuration.

questions.explanation: IMDSv2 exige un token de sesión obtenido con PUT, lo que mitiga SSRF. Los security groups no filtran el tráfico al servicio de metadatos, y las claves estáticas empeoran el riesgo.

questions.question:
Containers running on EC2 instances in an Amazon ECS cluster must not be able to obtain the credentials of the EC2 instance role. Each task must use its own permissions.

Which combination meets these requirements?

options.text: Assign an ECS task role to each task definition and set the IMDSv2 hop limit to 1 on the container instances (or block container access to IMDS).
Assign the permissions to the task execution role and remove the instance role.
Store access keys for each task in environment variables.
Increase the IMDS hop limit to 3 so that containers use IMDSv2.

questions.explanation: El task role da permisos propios a la aplicación; el task execution role es para que ECS descargue imágenes y escriba logs. Con hop limit 1, los contenedores en modo bridge no alcanzan IMDSv2 y no obtienen las credenciales del nodo.

questions.question:
An ECS task fails to start with an error that it cannot pull the container image from Amazon ECR or retrieve a secret from Secrets Manager that is referenced in the task definition. The application code itself does not call ECR or Secrets Manager.

Which role is missing the required permissions?

options.text: The task role.
The task execution role.
The IAM role of the user who created the service.
The ECS service-linked role.

questions.explanation: El task execution role lo usa el agente de ECS para descargar imágenes de ECR, enviar logs y obtener secretos referenciados en la definición. El task role es para las llamadas que hace el código de la aplicación.

questions.question:
A security engineer must protect a public Network Load Balancer that serves an HTTPS application against SQL injection. The engineer tries to associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the NLB but it is not listed.

What should the engineer do?

options.text: Enable AWS Shield Advanced on the NLB, which adds SQL injection protection.
Place an Application Load Balancer or a CloudFront distribution in front of the application and associate the web ACL with it, because AWS WAF cannot be associated with an NLB.
Use a security group on the NLB with a SQL injection rule.
Create the web ACL in us-east-1 with the CloudFront scope, which also supports NLBs.

questions.explanation: WAF se asocia a CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway REST, AppSync, Cognito user pools, App Runner y Verified Access, no a NLB. Shield Advanced protege contra DDoS, no contra SQLi.

questions.question:
A company is about to enable the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet on a production web ACL. The company is concerned about false positives that could block legitimate customers.

What should the security engineer do?

options.text: Add the rule group with its rule actions overridden to Count, analyze the WAF logs, then exclude or scope down problematic rules before switching to Block.
Enable the rule group in Block mode and roll back if customers complain.
Use a rate-based rule instead of the managed rule group.
Add the rule group to a separate web ACL that is not associated with any resource.

questions.explanation: El modo Count registra coincidencias sin bloquear. Con los logs se identifican falsos positivos y se ajustan exclusiones o scope-down statements antes de bloquear.

questions.question:
A login API is receiving a credential-stuffing attack from thousands of IP addresses, each sending a few requests. A rate-based rule keyed on IP address does not stop the attack.

Which AWS WAF capability is MOST effective?

options.text: A geographic match rule that blocks all countries except the home country.
A rate-based rule with a lower limit keyed on IP address.
The account takeover prevention (ATP) managed rule group on the login path.
An IP set that blocks the first 1,000 attacking IP addresses.

questions.explanation: ATP inspecciona los intentos de inicio de sesión (credenciales filtradas, patrones de abuso) aunque el ataque esté distribuido. Un límite por IP no sirve cuando cada IP envía pocas solicitudes.

questions.question:
A rate-based rule must limit requests per client. Many legitimate users share the same corporate egress IP address, and attackers rotate IP addresses frequently.

Which aggregation key should the security engineer consider?

options.text: The AWS Region of the web ACL.
A JA4 (or JA3) TLS fingerprint, optionally combined with other keys.
The Host header.
Only the source IP address.

questions.explanation: Desde 2025, las reglas rate-based pueden agregar por huellas JA3/JA4, que identifican al cliente TLS independientemente de la IP, y combinarlas con otras claves.

questions.question:
A security engineer must create an AWS WAF web ACL for a CloudFront distribution using the AWS CLI.

Which setting is required?

options.text: Create one web ACL per edge location.
Create the web ACL in any Region and replicate it with Firewall Manager.
Create the web ACL with the REGIONAL scope in the Region of the origin.
Create the web ACL with the CLOUDFRONT scope in the us-east-1 Region.

questions.explanation: Los web ACLs para CloudFront usan el scope CLOUDFRONT y se crean en us-east-1.

questions.question:
A company serves static content from an S3 bucket through CloudFront. The objects are encrypted with SSE-KMS. Users must not be able to access the bucket directly.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use origin access control (OAC), allow the CloudFront service principal in the bucket policy with an AWS:SourceArn condition for the distribution, and allow it to use the KMS key.
Use origin access identity (OAI) and grant it kms:Decrypt in the key policy.
Use an S3 website endpoint as the origin with a custom header.
Make the bucket public and restrict access with a Referer header condition.

questions.explanation: OAC es el método recomendado y, a diferencia de OAI, soporta SSE-KMS. La bucket policy permite cloudfront.amazonaws.com limitado al ARN de la distribución, y la key policy debe permitir el uso de la clave.

questions.question:
Premium subscribers of a video platform must be able to access hundreds of video segment files under /premium/* through CloudFront. The company does not want to change the URLs of the files.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use CloudFront signed cookies with a trusted key group.
Use S3 presigned URLs for each segment.
Use a CloudFront signed URL for each file.
Use a CloudFront geographic restriction.

questions.explanation: Las signed cookies permiten acceso a múltiples archivos sin cambiar las URLs; las signed URLs son por archivo. Se recomiendan trusted key groups en lugar de claves de la cuenta root.

questions.question:
An Application Load Balancer is the origin for a CloudFront distribution with AWS WAF. Attackers are bypassing CloudFront and WAF by sending requests directly to the ALB's DNS name.

Which combination of actions prevents this? (Choose the BEST option.)

options.text: Associate the same web ACL with the CloudFront distribution only.
Enable access logs on the ALB and block IP addresses that appear in the logs.
Move the ALB to a private subnet without any other change.
Restrict the ALB security group to the CloudFront managed prefix list and require a secret custom header added by CloudFront in an ALB listener rule.

questions.explanation: La prefix list limita el origen a IPs de CloudFront, y el encabezado secreto garantiza que la solicitud viene de tu distribución (otras distribuciones de CloudFront usan las mismas IPs). Otra alternativa es usar VPC origins con un ALB privado.

questions.question:
A form on a website collects national ID numbers. The company requires that only one backend microservice can decrypt this field, even though other services along the request path (including the origin web servers) process the request.

Which CloudFront feature meets this requirement?

options.text: Field-level encryption with a public key, so that only the service that has the private key can decrypt the field.
Signed cookies for the form path.
Viewer protocol policy set to HTTPS only.
Origin protocol policy set to HTTPS only.

questions.explanation: Field-level encryption cifra campos específicos en el borde con una clave pública; solo quien tiene la clave privada los descifra. HTTPS protege en tránsito, pero los servicios intermedios ven el texto plano.

questions.question:
A company protects CloudFront and ALB resources with AWS Shield Advanced. The company wants Layer 7 DDoS attacks to be mitigated automatically without having to write WAF rules during an attack.

What should the security engineer enable?

options.text: VPC Flow Logs with an automated Lambda response.
Shield Advanced automatic application layer DDoS mitigation, with a web ACL associated with the protected resources.
Shield Standard on the resources.
A Network Firewall stateless rule group.

questions.explanation: La mitigación automática de capa de aplicación crea y gestiona reglas en el web ACL asociado cuando detecta un ataque. Requiere que el recurso tenga un web ACL.

questions.question:
Workloads in several VPCs must reach only an approved list of external domains over HTTPS. All other outbound internet traffic must be blocked and logged.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use AWS WAF on the NAT gateway to filter domains.
Route egress traffic through AWS Network Firewall in a centralized inspection VPC with a stateful domain list rule group (allowlist on TLS SNI and HTTP Host) and a default drop.
Use security groups with the domain names in outbound rules.
Use network ACLs with the IP addresses of the domains.

questions.explanation: Las domain lists de Network Firewall filtran por SNI (TLS) y Host (HTTP). Los security groups y NACLs no entienden nombres de dominio, y WAF no se asocia con un NAT gateway.

questions.question:
A centralized Network Firewall inspects traffic from 20 spoke VPCs attached to a transit gateway. Suricata rules that use $HOME_NET do not match traffic from the spoke VPCs.

What should the security engineer do?

options.text: Deploy a separate firewall in each spoke VPC.
Enable TLS inspection on the firewall.
Expand the HOME_NET rule variable in the firewall policy to include the CIDR ranges of all spoke VPCs.
Convert all stateful rules to stateless rules.

questions.explanation: Por defecto HOME_NET es el CIDR de la VPC donde está el firewall. En un modelo centralizado hay que ampliarlo con los rangos de las spoke VPCs.

questions.question:
Malware hides command-and-control traffic inside TLS connections to domains that look legitimate. The security team needs Network Firewall to inspect the decrypted content of outbound HTTPS traffic.

What should the security engineer configure?

options.text: A TLS inspection configuration on the firewall with a certificate from AWS Certificate Manager trusted by the clients.
A stateless rule group that drops port 443.
VPC Traffic Mirroring of the encrypted traffic to the firewall.
A domain list rule group with the suspicious domains.

questions.explanation: La inspección TLS de Network Firewall descifra, inspecciona y vuelve a cifrar el tráfico con un certificado en ACM en el que confían los clientes.

questions.question:
A network ACL on a public subnet allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0. Clients cannot complete connections to the web server in the subnet, although the security group allows inbound 443.

What is the cause?

options.text: Network ACLs are stateless; the outbound rules must also allow responses to the clients' ephemeral ports (for example, 1024-65535).
Network ACLs must allow inbound ICMP for TCP connections.
The NACL rule numbers must be greater than 100.
Security groups must also allow outbound 443 for the responses.

questions.explanation: Las NACLs no rastrean conexiones: la respuesta del servidor sale hacia el puerto efímero del cliente y debe estar permitida. Los security groups sí son stateful.

questions.question:
A security engineer must block a single malicious IP address from reaching any instance in a subnet while all other traffic continues to be allowed by the existing security groups.

What should the engineer do?

options.text: Add a network ACL deny rule for the IP address with a lower rule number than the allow rules.
Remove the IP address range from the route table.
Create a VPC endpoint policy that denies the IP address.
Add a deny rule for the IP address to each security group.

questions.explanation: Los security groups solo admiten reglas Allow. Las NACLs admiten Deny y se evalúan en orden ascendente por número de regla.

questions.question:
An S3 bucket policy denies access unless aws:SourceIp matches the company's VPC CIDR range. Instances in the VPC access S3 through a gateway VPC endpoint and receive AccessDenied.

What should the security engineer do?

options.text: Change the gateway endpoint to an interface endpoint.
Replace the aws:SourceIp condition with aws:SourceVpce (or aws:SourceVpc), because requests through a VPC endpoint do not carry a public source IP that matches.
Add the private IP addresses of the instances to aws:SourceIp.
Add a NAT gateway so that requests use a public IP address.

questions.explanation: Con un VPC endpoint, aws:SourceIp no aplica para IPs privadas de la VPC. Se usa aws:SourceVpce o aws:SourceVpc para restringir el origen.

questions.question:
Instances in a private subnet must download objects only from buckets owned by the company's AWS organization, to prevent data exfiltration to personal buckets through the S3 gateway endpoint.

What should the security engineer configure?

options.text: A security group rule that allows only the S3 prefix list.
A network ACL that denies all S3 IP ranges except the company's.
A bucket policy on the company's buckets with aws:SourceVpce.
A VPC endpoint policy that allows S3 actions only when aws:ResourceOrgID equals the company's organization ID.

questions.explanation: La endpoint policy controla qué recursos pueden alcanzarse a través del endpoint. aws:ResourceOrgID limita los buckets a la organización. Una bucket policy propia no impide escribir en buckets ajenos.

questions.question:
A company provides an internal API to 50 consumer VPCs in other accounts. The VPCs have overlapping CIDR ranges, and consumers must not have network-level access to any other resource in the provider VPC.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Attach all VPCs to a transit gateway with a shared route table.
Expose the API through a Network Load Balancer as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service and have consumers create interface endpoints.
Expose the API publicly and restrict it with security groups.
Create VPC peering connections with each consumer VPC.

questions.explanation: PrivateLink expone un único servicio, funciona con CIDR solapados y no da acceso al resto de la VPC. El peering y el transit gateway requieren CIDR no solapados y dan conectividad de red.

questions.question:
The security team must verify that no path exists from the internet to the database subnets across all VPCs, and identify any network path that violates this requirement.

Which tool should the security engineer use?

options.text: Reachability Analyzer between one internet gateway and one database instance.
Amazon GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring.
VPC Flow Logs filtered by REJECT.
Network Access Analyzer with a Network Access Scope that defines internet gateways as sources and the database subnets as destinations.

questions.explanation: Network Access Analyzer evalúa todos los caminos que coinciden con un scope; Reachability Analyzer analiza un par origen-destino concreto. Flow Logs solo muestra tráfico observado.

questions.question:
A company wants continuous vulnerability scanning of EC2 instances, container images in Amazon ECR, and Lambda functions in all accounts, with findings rescanned when new CVEs are published.

Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Enable Amazon Inspector with a delegated administrator and auto-enable EC2, ECR, and Lambda scanning for all member accounts.
Use AWS Config managed rules for vulnerability detection.
Use GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring on all resources.
Enable ECR basic scanning and run a monthly scan on EC2 with a third-party tool.

questions.explanation: Inspector escanea EC2, imágenes de ECR y Lambda de forma continua y reevalúa al publicarse nuevas CVE. El escaneo básico de ECR solo analiza al subir la imagen o de forma manual.

questions.question:
Amazon Inspector shows EC2 instances as unmanaged and does not produce vulnerability findings for them. The company does not want to install additional agents.

What should the security engineer do?

options.text: Attach an Elastic IP address to each instance.
Enable agentless scanning in Amazon Inspector (hybrid scan mode), which scans EBS snapshots of instances that are not managed by SSM.
Enable GuardDuty Malware Protection for EC2.
Install the CloudWatch agent on the instances.

questions.explanation: Inspector escanea EC2 con el SSM Agent o, en modo híbrido, sin agente mediante snapshots de EBS para las instancias no administradas.

questions.question:
A CI/CD pipeline builds container images. The security team requires that the pipeline fail if an image contains a vulnerability with critical severity, before the image is pushed to production.

Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Enable ECR enhanced scanning and review findings weekly.
Use AWS Config to detect vulnerable images after deployment.
Enable GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring on the cluster.
Add a CodeBuild step that generates an SBOM and calls the Amazon Inspector scanning integration for CI/CD, failing the build when critical vulnerabilities are found.

questions.explanation: La integración CI/CD de Inspector evalúa la imagen durante el build y permite fallar según severidad, antes de publicar. El resto de opciones detecta después del despliegue.

questions.question:
A CodePipeline pipeline in a tools account deploys to a production account. The artifact bucket is encrypted with the AWS managed key aws/s3, and the deployment role in the production account cannot read the artifacts.

What should the security engineer do?

options.text: Encrypt the artifact bucket with a customer managed KMS key whose key policy allows the production account role, and grant the role access in the bucket policy.
Disable encryption on the artifact bucket.
Copy the artifacts to a public bucket for the deployment.
Grant the production role kms:Decrypt on the aws/s3 key in its identity-based policy.

questions.explanation: Las AWS managed keys no admiten acceso entre cuentas. Para pipelines entre cuentas se usa una customer managed key compartida y una bucket policy que permita el rol de destino.

questions.question:
A CodeBuild project needs a database password during the build. The password must not appear in the buildspec file, the source repository, or the console as plain text.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Store the password as a plaintext environment variable in the CodeBuild project.
Store the password in Secrets Manager and reference it in the env/secrets-manager section of the buildspec, granting the CodeBuild service role access to the secret.
Store the password in an S3 object with public read access.
Commit the password to the repository encrypted with Base64.

questions.explanation: CodeBuild obtiene secretos de Secrets Manager o Parameter Store en tiempo de ejecución sin exponerlos en el código. Base64 no es cifrado.

questions.question:
A company must produce monthly AMIs that are hardened to a DISA STIG baseline, include the latest patches, and are scanned for vulnerabilities before being shared with workload accounts.

Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Use an EC2 Image Builder pipeline with STIG hardening components, a schedule, Amazon Inspector scanning, and distribution settings that share the AMI with the workload accounts.
Use AWS Config to harden the AMIs after they are shared.
Manually launch an instance each month, apply the STIG settings, and create an AMI.
Use Systems Manager Patch Manager to create AMIs.

questions.explanation: Image Builder automatiza construcción, endurecimiento (componentes STIG), pruebas, escaneo y distribución de imágenes.

questions.question:
The security team must ensure that developers can launch EC2 instances only from AMIs produced by the company's image pipeline account.

Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Enable Allowed AMIs for the accounts (for example, through a declarative policy) that permits only images owned by the image pipeline account.
Make the approved AMIs public.
Use an AWS Config rule that terminates instances launched from other AMIs.
Tag the approved AMIs and rely on developers to filter by tag.

questions.explanation: Allowed AMIs restringe preventivamente qué imágenes se pueden descubrir y usar; puede aplicarse a nivel de organización con políticas declarativas. Config solo detecta después del lanzamiento.

questions.question:
Patches must be applied first to development instances and, seven days later, to production instances. Patch compliance must be reported for both environments.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Create separate patch baselines with different auto-approval delays (0 days for development, 7 days for production) and apply them with patch policies or maintenance windows running AWS-RunPatchBaseline.
Use Amazon Inspector to install patches in production after seven days.
Use one patch baseline and run AWS-RunPatchBaseline with the Scan operation in production.
Create an AMI each week and replace production instances manually.

questions.explanation: El auto-approval delay de cada baseline define cuántos días después de la publicación se aprueba un parche. Scan solo reporta; Install aplica los parches.

questions.question:
A security engineer wants to know which managed instances are missing critical security patches without installing anything during business hours.

What should the engineer run?

options.text: AWS-RunPatchBaseline with the Operation parameter set to Install and RebootOption NoReboot.
AWS-UpdateSSMAgent on all instances.
An Amazon Inspector CIS benchmark scan.
AWS-RunPatchBaseline with the Operation parameter set to Scan.

questions.explanation: La operación Scan compara las instancias contra el baseline y reporta el cumplimiento sin instalar nada.

questions.question:
A company has a 100 Gbps dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection. Regulations require encryption of all traffic between the on-premises router and AWS at line rate.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use TLS in every application that uses the connection.
Direct Connect encrypts all traffic by default.
Run a Site-to-Site VPN over the Direct Connect public virtual interface.
Enable MACsec on the dedicated connection with a CKN/CAK pair on supported devices.

questions.explanation: MACsec cifra en capa 2 a velocidad de línea en conexiones dedicadas compatibles. Una VPN IPsec tiene un límite de ancho de banda por túnel, y Direct Connect no cifra por defecto.

questions.question:
A company uses Direct Connect with a transit virtual interface. The company must encrypt traffic with IPsec but does not want the VPN tunnels to use public IP addresses or traverse the internet.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use AWS Client VPN for the data center.
Enable MACsec on a hosted connection.
Create a private IP Site-to-Site VPN attached to the transit gateway over the Direct Connect transit virtual interface.
Create a standard Site-to-Site VPN over the internet with BGP.

questions.explanation: La VPN de IP privada usa direcciones privadas para los túneles IPsec sobre Direct Connect, sin exponerse a internet.

questions.question:
A company wants to authenticate Site-to-Site VPN tunnels with certificates instead of pre-shared keys.

What should the security engineer use?

options.text: Private certificates issued by AWS Private CA (through ACM) for the customer gateway.
A certificate imported into Secrets Manager.
IAM server certificates.
Public certificates from ACM.

questions.explanation: La autenticación de túneles con certificados usa certificados privados emitidos por AWS Private CA en lugar de claves precompartidas.

questions.question:
Remote employees need access to applications in a VPC. Access must use the corporate SAML identity provider with MFA, and the security team wants to authorize access by user group to specific CIDR ranges.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: A public NLB with security groups per employee IP.
Site-to-Site VPN from each employee's home router.
AWS Client VPN with SAML-based federated authentication and authorization rules per group.
Direct Connect hosted connections for each employee.

questions.explanation: Client VPN admite autenticación federada SAML (con MFA del IdP) y authorization rules por grupo hacia redes específicas.

questions.question:
A company wants employees to access internal web applications without a VPN. Access decisions must consider the user's identity group and the security posture of the device for every request.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: AWS Client VPN with certificate authentication.
Amazon Cognito user pools with an ALB authentication action only.
An internet-facing ALB with AWS WAF IP sets.
AWS Verified Access with an identity trust provider (for example, IAM Identity Center) and a device trust provider, using Cedar access policies.

questions.explanation: Verified Access aplica Zero Trust: evalúa identidad y postura del dispositivo en cada solicitud mediante políticas Cedar, sin VPN.

questions.question:
A company uses Amazon Bedrock for a customer support chatbot. Responses must never include customer email addresses or phone numbers, and must not discuss investment advice.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Configure an Amazon Bedrock guardrail with sensitive information filters that mask or block email and phone PII and a denied topic for investment advice.
Add instructions to the system prompt telling the model not to reveal PII or give investment advice.
Use Amazon Macie to scan each response before returning it.
Use an AWS WAF rule to block responses that contain email addresses.

questions.explanation: Los guardrails aplican controles fuera del modelo: filtros de información sensible (PII o regex) y denied topics. Las instrucciones en el prompt pueden eludirse; Macie solo analiza S3.

questions.question:
The security team must ensure that every call to Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel in the account uses an approved guardrail, so developers cannot bypass it.

Which solution meets this requirement?

options.text: Attach the guardrail to the foundation model in the Bedrock console.
Use an AWS Config rule to detect calls without a guardrail.
Use an IAM policy (or SCP) condition on bedrock:GuardrailIdentifier that denies InvokeModel requests without the approved guardrail.
Enable model invocation logging and review logs weekly.

questions.explanation: La condición bedrock:GuardrailIdentifier permite exigir un guardrail específico en las llamadas de inferencia. El logging y Config solo detectan.

questions.question:
A company hosts its own open-source LLM on Amazon SageMaker and wants to apply the same content filters and PII protections that it uses with Amazon Bedrock guardrails.

What should the company do?

options.text: Bedrock guardrails can be used only with Bedrock foundation models; build custom filters.
Call the ApplyGuardrail API to evaluate the prompts and responses of the self-hosted model against the guardrail.
Enable Amazon Macie on the SageMaker endpoint.
Import the model into AWS WAF.

questions.explanation: ApplyGuardrail evalúa texto contra un guardrail sin invocar un modelo de Bedrock, por lo que sirve para modelos propios o de terceros.

questions.question: An AI agent built with Amazon Bedrock can call internal APIs. Which controls mitigate the OWASP Top 10 for LLM risks of prompt injection and excessive agency? (Select THREE.)

options.text: Enable the prompt attack content filter in a guardrail
Give the agent AdministratorAccess so it never fails
Increase the model temperature
Require human confirmation before the agent performs destructive actions
Give the agent's IAM role only the permissions it needs for the specific actions
Disable model invocation logging

questions.explanation: El filtro Prompt Attack detecta inyección; mínimo privilegio y confirmación humana limitan la excessive agency. Más temperatura o menos logging no ayudan.

questions.question:
A fleet of 50,000 IoT devices connects to AWS IoT Core. Each device must publish only to its own MQTT topic devices/<thingName>/telemetry, using one shared policy.

Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Use a unique X.509 certificate per device and an IoT policy that uses the ${iot:Connection.Thing.ThingName} policy variable in the topic ARN.
Use IAM users with access keys for each device.
Use one certificate for all devices and a policy that lists all topics.
Create one IoT policy per device that lists its topic.

questions.explanation: Una identidad única por dispositivo más policy variables permite una sola política que restringe a cada dispositivo a su propio topic.

questions.question:
The security team wants to be alerted when an IoT device suddenly sends far more messages than usual or connects from an unexpected IP address.

Which feature should the security engineer use?

options.text: AWS IoT Device Defender Audit.
AWS Config rules for IoT.
AWS IoT Device Defender Detect with security profiles (rules-based or ML-based).
Amazon GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring.

questions.explanation: Device Defender Detect monitoriza el comportamiento de los dispositivos frente a perfiles de seguridad; Audit revisa configuraciones (por ejemplo, políticas demasiado permisivas).

questions.question: Order the steps to deploy centralized egress inspection with AWS Network Firewall for several VPCs.

options.text: Create an inspection VPC with firewall subnets in each Availability Zone
Create the firewall with a firewall policy and rule groups
Attach the spoke VPCs and the inspection VPC to a transit gateway
Update transit gateway and VPC route tables to send traffic through the firewall endpoints
Enable firewall logging and verify traffic flows

questions.explanation: Primero la infraestructura de inspección y el firewall, luego la conectividad y las rutas que dirigen el tráfico por los endpoints, y finalmente el logging y la verificación.

questions.question: Match each AWS WAF feature with its use case.

options.text: Require a human puzzle before allowing the request
Test a rule without blocking requests
Identify and manage automated traffic
Limit requests per client over a time window
Encrypt request bodies
Detect credential stuffing on a login page

questions.explanation: Cada función resuelve un problema distinto; WAF no cifra el cuerpo de las solicitudes.

questions.question: Match each requirement with the MOST appropriate network control.

prompts.text: Allow traffic from the web tier security group only
Deny a specific IP address at the subnet level
Filter outbound traffic by domain name for all VPCs
Block DNS resolution of malicious domains
Private access to S3 without an internet gateway

options.text: Network ACL
Security group referencing another security group
Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
Gateway VPC endpoint
Internet gateway
AWS Network Firewall

questions.explanation: Cada control actúa en una capa distinta de la red; un internet gateway da acceso a internet en lugar de restringirlo.

questions.question: A security engineer must enforce secure communication for a CloudFront distribution with a custom origin. Which configurations should the engineer apply? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Enable field-level encryption for all fields
Disable caching on the distribution
Set the viewer protocol policy to redirect HTTP to HTTPS (or HTTPS only)
Use a CloudFront signed URL for every request
Set the origin protocol policy to HTTPS only

questions.explanation: La viewer protocol policy protege el tramo cliente-CloudFront, y la origin protocol policy el tramo CloudFront-origen.
